name: May This Be the Summer of Sambal-Smashed Fried Chicken

instructions.primary_message: In a mixing bowl or mortar and pestle, smash the fried chicken until pulverized into large chunks. Spoon enough sauce on top to coat generously and stir and smash until thoroughly combined. Stir in more sauce, if desired. Serve on rice.

description: Based on the Indonesian street food called ayam geprek, this recipe features crisp boneless fried chicken smashed with flavorful and spicy condiments. It's even more delicious than it is easy and quick.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Homemade or store-bought sambal, chili crisp, or other flavorful sauce of your choice (see notes); White rice, for serving
